blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos on Tuesday announced that the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) and the United States have adopted the 10 Public-Private Partnership Principles for Tackling Online Scams and the Comprehensive Work Plan to guide their strategic partnership. He made the announcement during the Asean-US Special Summit with US President Donald Trump, who arrived in the Philippines minutes before the closing of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits. “In anticipation of your arrival, Mr. President [Trump], and knowing your desire for results and not just talk, our staff has been working together, Asean and your staff have […]... Keep on reading: Marcos: Asean, US adopt online scam principles, comprehensive work plan
